Awesome great game its one for the long haul

Highly recommended.

The game in itself isn't very beginner friendly (There is a lot you need to figure out) but the community is very helpful, and it's beyond rare you won't get an answer to your questions.

game is fully free to play, and everything can be earned through playing. Whenever you buy something it's only to get that item faster, and not exclusively through paying. 

Take your time figure things out, and you'll have a game you'll enjoy for many many hours!

OVERVIEW 

Warframe is one of those games that resides in a very special place in my heart. On Ps4, I've been following this game since its release and it has a very unique way of contineously bringing me back with its never ending content. For a free-to-play game, Warframe provides the player with so much to accomplish and satisfies with an overwhelming sense of progression. Even if you fail a misssion, you still don't even feel that it was a waste, for you still get a fraction of exp gathered. Even though I recomend playing with friends or make an original clan, in-game social group, warframe will keep you well entertained playing solo. If you worry about coming on to the game too late, you have nothing to worry about, for it's still a live game with plentiful amounts of future content coming to this game, such as a long anticipated Umbra quest and loads of more weapons and vanity items.

CONCLUSION

Digital Extremes forged a generous masterpiece when it comes to a free-to-play title, offering players hours upon hours of playtime with satisfying gameplay and a semi-descent story. Keep in mind that there are alot of microtransactions, but none of them represent the despicable play-to-win style unlike certain AAA titles that shall not be named. If your looking for a new game to get into a don't currently have any shabanks, then I profoundly suggest you invest your time into this lovely game. Truly the quintessence of a free-to-play game.

VERDICT

10/10
